prompts.atk: Cinematic 4K military footage, dynamic aerial chase tracking Chengdu J-20A Mighty Dragon Flight (USA) flying at high speed. Fires primary weapon (autocannon) with intense rocket motor plume, contrails swirling in low-light dusk sky, photorealistic cockpit HUD reflection and heat shimmer.
prompts.def: High-speed aerial combat sequence, Chengdu J-20A Mighty Dragon Flight banks sharply in high-G defensive break maneuver, deploying a salvo of bright magnesium infrared flares and chaff cartridges against incoming threat, afterburners pulsing against cloud layer.
prompts.win: Air superiority victory shot, camera pans past Chengdu J-20A Mighty Dragon Flight as a distant hostile aircraft bursts into a massive fireball with debris disintegrating into the ocean below, pilot executes combat barrel roll over horizon.
prompts.loss: Grim military reportage, Chengdu J-20A Mighty Dragon Flight suffers critical missile impact on left wing, thick black smoke and orange flames streaming from fuselage as aircraft spins out of control towards terrain, emergency ejection sequence initiated.
